The Role of Deliberative Processing in Behavioural Regulation

It is interesting to note that most of models for behaviour have a focus on the automatic, impulsive part of behavioural regulation. However, deliberation has not disappeared from the scene and makes up a part of some models. The Mode-Model by Fazio consists of two different classes of processes that can regulate behaviour.
